name: PLKS (Pas Lawatan Kerja Sementara, Temporary Work Visit Pass)

requirements.blocker_text: Limited to designated low- and semi-skilled sectors (manufacturing, construction, agriculture, plantation, and services including domestic work), and to source countries with which Malaysia has an active recruitment agreement.

Requires a job offer from a Malaysian employer holding an approved foreign-worker quota for the sector, who pays an annual levy per worker to the Immigration Department in addition to the worker's wages.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer with an approved sectoral quota.

evidence_required.document: Employer's approved foreign-worker quota and levy payment
FOMEMA (Foreign Workers Medical Examination Monitoring Agency) medical clearance
Employment contract and passport valid for the permit period

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable up to a maximum cumulative period (commonly cited as 10 years for most sectors, with sector-specific variation)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: tied to the specific sponsoring employer and sector; changing employer generally requires a fresh application rather than a simple transfer

sources.title: MalaysiaVisas.com -- general overview of Malaysia's foreign-worker permit (PLKS) system, levy structure, and sectoral quota mechanism

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of the Immigration Department of Malaysia's or Ministry of Home Affairs's own PLKS procedural or levy-rate pages was achieved in this research pass -- this route rests on general secondary-source knowledge rather than specific, dated, government-confirmed figures, and levy rates and source-country agreements are known to change relatively frequently in practice. Structurally, PLKS is Malaysia's low/semi-skilled counterpart to the Employment Pass -- the two systems are entirely separate administratively, with PLKS workers subject to sectoral quotas and an employer-paid levy (a direct cost on top of wages) rather than the salary-threshold test that gates Employment Pass eligibility. leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship are set to false rather than left ambiguous, since no source found in this research pass documented any settlement pathway for PLKS holders -- unlike the Employment Pass, which does chain toward my_permanent_residence's professional/points track, PLKS appears to function as a structurally closed-loop temporary labour channel with no confirmed onward route, similar in shape to Korea's E-9 EPS system elsewhere in this dataset. This is flagged as the most likely area for factual gaps in the Malaysia build and should be the top priority for a follow-up session's tier-1 verification effort, particularly given the real-world scale of this route (foreign workers on PLKS-equivalent permits are estimated in the millions across Malaysia's economy).
